name: portal_private.diagnosis_lessons
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_private.diagnosis_lessons(p_user uuid, p_track text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with accessible_exams as materialized (
  -- Resolve expensive assignment permissions once per exam, before unnesting.
  select e.id,e.question_ids from public.exams e where e.track_id=p_track
   and ((e.is_published and public.exam_assigned_to(e.id,p_user)) or exists(
    select 1 from public.attempts a where a.exam_id=e.id and a.user_id=p_user and a.status in ('submitted','graded','expired')))
 ), catalog_ids as materialized (
  select distinct unnest(question_ids) as question_id from accessible_exams
 ), eligible as materialized (
  select a.* from public.attempts a join public.exams e on e.id=a.exam_id
  where a.user_id=p_user and e.track_id=p_track and a.status in ('submitted','graded','expired')
   and a.score is not null and e.review_policy='full_review'
   and a.review_unlocks_at is not null and a.review_unlocks_at<=now()
   and exists(select 1 from public.attempt_answers aa where aa.attempt_id=a.id
    and aa.response is not null and aa.response not in ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb))
 ), latest as materialized (
  select distinct on (r.question_id) r.question_id,r.is_correct,a.submitted_at,
   (aa.response is null or aa.response in ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb)) as blank
  from eligible a join public.exams e on e.id=a.exam_id
  join public.attempt_results r on r.attempt_id=a.id and r.question_id=any(e.question_ids)
  left join public.attempt_answers aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id and aa.question_id=r.question_id
  where r.is_correct is not null
  order by r.question_id,a.submitted_at desc nulls last,a.attempt_no desc,a.id desc
 ), coverage as (
  select coalesce(nullif(btrim(q.assets->>'curriculum_lesson'),''),nullif(btrim(q.topic),''),'Unclassified questions') as lesson,
   count(*)::int as seen,count(*) filter(where l.is_correct)::int as correct,
   count(*) filter(where not l.is_correct)::int as missed,
   count(*) filter(where not l.is_correct and l.blank)::int as blank,max(l.submitted_at) as last_practiced
  from latest l join public.questions q on q.id=l.question_id join public.question_keys k on k.question_id=q.id
  where portal_private.question_eligible(q,k,p_track,false) group by 1
 ), catalog as (
  select distinct coalesce(nullif(btrim(q.assets->>'curriculum_lesson'),''),nullif(btrim(q.topic),''),'Unclassified questions') as lesson
  from catalog_ids eq join public.questions q on q.id=eq.question_id join public.question_keys k on k.question_id=q.id
  where portal_private.question_eligible(q,k,p_track,false)
 ), ranked as (
  select c.lesson,c.lesson not in ('Mixed / untagged','Unclassified questions') as classified,
   coalesce(v.seen,0) as seen,coalesce(v.correct,0) as correct,coalesce(v.missed,0) as missed,
   coalesce(v.blank,0) as blank,round(100.0*v.correct/nullif(v.seen,0)) as percent,v.last_practiced,
   case when c.lesson in ('Mixed / untagged','Unclassified questions') then 'more_evidence'
    when coalesce(v.seen,0)=0 then 'not_started' when v.seen<3 then 'more_evidence'
    when round(100.0*v.correct/v.seen)<60 then 'focus' when round(100.0*v.correct/v.seen)<80 then 'practice' else 'strong' end as priority
  from catalog c left join coverage v on v.lesson=c.lesson
 ) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by
  case priority when 'focus' then 1 when 'practice' then 2 when 'more_evidence' then 3 when 'not_started' then 4 else 5 end,
  percent nulls last,lesson collate "C"),'[]'::jsonb) from ranked r;
$function$

name: portal_private.diagnosis_lessons_batch
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_private.diagnosis_lessons_batch(p_users uuid[], p_track text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, lessons jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with users as materialized (
  select distinct unnest(p_users) as user_id
 ), exams as materialized (
  select e.* from public.exams e where e.track_id=p_track
 ), attempts as materialized (
  select a.* from public.attempts a join users u on u.user_id=a.user_id
  join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id where a.status in ('submitted','graded','expired')
 ), access as materialized (
  select a.user_id,a.exam_id from public.assignments a join users u on u.user_id=a.user_id
  join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id where e.is_published
  union
  select gm.user_id,a.exam_id from public.assignments a
  join public.group_members gm on gm.group_id=a.group_id join users u on u.user_id=gm.user_id
  join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id where e.is_published
  union
  select a.user_id,a.exam_id from attempts a
 ), catalog_ids as materialized (
  select distinct a.user_id,unnest(e.question_ids) as question_id
  from access a join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id
 ), question_ids as materialized (
  select distinct c.question_id from catalog_ids c
 ), questions as materialized (
  select q.id,coalesce(nullif(btrim(q.assets->>'curriculum_lesson'),''),nullif(btrim(q.topic),''),'Unclassified questions') as lesson
  from question_ids ids join public.questions q on q.id=ids.question_id
  join public.question_keys k on k.question_id=q.id
  where portal_private.question_eligible(q,k,p_track,false)
 ), eligible as materialized (
  select a.* from attempts a join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id
  where a.score is not null and e.review_policy='full_review'
   and a.review_unlocks_at is not null and a.review_unlocks_at<=now()
   and exists(select 1 from public.attempt_answers aa where aa.attempt_id=a.id
    and aa.response is not null and aa.response not in ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb))
 ), latest as materialized (
  select distinct on (a.user_id,r.question_id) a.user_id,r.question_id,r.is_correct,a.submitted_at,
   (aa.response is null or aa.response in ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb)) as blank
  from eligible a join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id
  join public.attempt_results r on r.attempt_id=a.id and r.question_id=any(e.question_ids)
  left join public.attempt_answers aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id and aa.question_id=r.question_id
  where r.is_correct is not null
  order by a.user_id,r.question_id,a.submitted_at desc nulls last,a.attempt_no desc,a.id desc
 ), coverage as (
  select l.user_id,q.lesson,count(*)::int as seen,count(*) filter(where l.is_correct)::int as correct,
   count(*) filter(where not l.is_correct)::int as missed,
   count(*) filter(where not l.is_correct and l.blank)::int as blank,max(l.submitted_at) as last_practiced
  from latest l join questions q on q.id=l.question_id group by l.user_id,q.lesson
 ), catalog as (
  select distinct c.user_id,q.lesson from catalog_ids c join questions q on q.id=c.question_id
 ), ranked as (
  select c.user_id,c.lesson,c.lesson not in ('Mixed / untagged','Unclassified questions') as classified,
   coalesce(v.seen,0) as seen,coalesce(v.correct,0) as correct,coalesce(v.missed,0) as missed,
   coalesce(v.blank,0) as blank,round(100.0*v.correct/nullif(v.seen,0)) as percent,v.last_practiced,
   case when c.lesson in ('Mixed / untagged','Unclassified questions') then 'more_evidence'
    when coalesce(v.seen,0)=0 then 'not_started' when v.seen<3 then 'more_evidence'
    when round(100.0*v.correct/v.seen)<60 then 'focus' when round(100.0*v.correct/v.seen)<80 then 'practice' else 'strong' end as priority
  from catalog c left join coverage v on v.user_id=c.user_id and v.lesson=c.lesson
 ), reports as (
  select r.user_id,jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'user_id' order by
   case priority when 'focus' then 1 when 'practice' then 2 when 'more_evidence' then 3 when 'not_started' then 4 else 5 end,
   percent nulls last,lesson collate "C") as lessons from ranked r group by r.user_id
 ) select u.user_id,coalesce(r.lessons,'[]'::jsonb) from users u left join reports r on r.user_id=u.user_id;
$function$

name: portal_private.record_notebook_activity
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION portal_private.record_notebook_activity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.tries > old.tries then
    insert into portal_private.notebook_activity(user_id,track_id,day,question_id,started_at,completed_at)
    select new.user_id,q.track_id,(now() at time zone 'Africa/Cairo')::date,new.question_id,
      now(),case when new.correct_streak>0 then now() end
    from public.questions q where q.id=new.question_id
    on conflict(user_id,track_id,day,question_id) do update
      set completed_at=coalesce(notebook_activity.completed_at,excluded.completed_at);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

name: public.practice_notebook_state
args: p_user uuid, p_track text, p_offset integer
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.practice_notebook_state(p_user uuid, p_track text, p_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_items jsonb; v_count int; v_done int;
begin
  if not public.is_enrolled(p_user,p_track) then raise exception 'not_enrolled_in_track'; end if;
  if p_offset<0 or p_offset>10000 then raise exception 'invalid_page'; end if;
  insert into public.practice_notebook(user_id,question_id)
  select distinct p_user,r.question_id from public.attempt_results r
  join public.attempts a on a.id=r.attempt_id join public.exams e on e.id=a.exam_id
  join public.questions q on q.id=r.question_id and q.track_id=e.track_id
  join public.question_keys k on k.question_id=q.id
  where a.user_id=p_user and e.track_id=p_track and r.is_correct=false
    and a.status in ('graded','expired') and a.score is not null
    and e.review_policy='full_review' and a.review_unlocks_at<=now()
    and jsonb_typeof(k.correct) in ('string','array') and portal_private.question_eligible(q,k,p_track,false) on conflict do nothing;
  insert into public.practice_notebook(user_id,question_id)
  select distinct p_user,q.id from public.daily_progress dp
  cross join lateral jsonb_each(dp.answers) answer_(qid,response)
  join public.questions q on q.id=answer_.qid::uuid and q.track_id=dp.track_id
  join public.question_keys k on k.question_id=q.id
  where dp.user_id=p_user and dp.track_id=p_track and dp.quiz_completed_at is not null
    and not public.answer_matches(q.type,answer_.response,k.correct)
    and jsonb_typeof(k.correct) in ('string','array') and portal_private.question_eligible(q,k,p_track,false) on conflict do nothing;
  select count(*) filter(where n.correct_streak<2),count(*) filter(where n.correct_streak=2)
    into v_count,v_done from public.practice_notebook n join public.questions q on q.id=n.question_id
    join public.question_keys k on k.question_id=q.id
    where n.user_id=p_user and q.track_id=p_track and portal_private.question_eligible(q,k,p_track,false);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',q.id,'stem',q.stem,'topic',q.topic,
    'type',q.type,'choices',q.choices,'assets',q.assets,'streak',n.correct_streak,'tries',n.tries)
    order by q.topic,q.id),'[]'::jsonb) into v_items
  from (select n.question_id,n.correct_streak,n.tries,n.updated_at
    from public.practice_notebook n join public.questions page_q on page_q.id=n.question_id
    join public.question_keys page_k on page_k.question_id=page_q.id
    where n.user_id=p_user and page_q.track_id=p_track and n.correct_streak<2
      and portal_private.question_eligible(page_q,page_k,p_track,false)
    order by page_q.topic,n.question_id limit 25 offset p_offset) n
  join public.questions q on q.id=n.question_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('track',p_track,'remaining',v_count,'mastered',v_done,'items',v_items,'offset',p_offset);
end $function$

name: public.student_dashboard
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.student_dashboard(p_user uuid, p_track text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
 SET jit TO 'off'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
declare history_ jsonb; lessons_ jsonb; summary_ jsonb;
begin
 if not public.course_history_access(p_user,p_track) then raise exception 'not_enrolled_in_track'; end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',a.id,'exam_id',e.id,'title',e.title,'assessment_type',e.assessment_type,
  'attempt_no',a.attempt_no,'status',a.status,'score',a.score,'total',a.total,
  'percent',round(100.0*a.score/nullif(a.total,0)),'scaled_score',a.scaled_score,
  'submitted_at',a.submitted_at,'time_used',a.time_used,
  'review_open',e.review_policy='full_review' and a.review_unlocks_at is not null and a.review_unlocks_at<=now(),
  'review_unlocks_at',a.review_unlocks_at,
  'answered_count',(select count(*) from public.attempt_answers aa where aa.attempt_id=a.id and aa.response is not null and aa.response not in ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb))
 ) order by a.submitted_at desc nulls last,a.attempt_no desc,a.id desc),'[]'::jsonb) into history_
 from attempts a join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id
 where a.user_id=p_user and e.track_id=p_track and a.status in ('submitted','graded','expired');

 lessons_:=portal_private.diagnosis_lessons(p_user,p_track);

 select jsonb_build_object('completed',count(*),'average_percent',round(avg(100.0*a.score/nullif(a.total,0))),
 'best_percent',round(max(100.0*a.score/nullif(a.total,0))),
 'questions_answered',coalesce(sum(a.total),0),
 'lessons_to_focus',(select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(lessons_) l where l->>'priority'='focus'),
 'review_pending',count(*) filter(where not(e.review_policy='full_review' and a.review_unlocks_at is not null and a.review_unlocks_at<=now())))
 into summary_ from attempts a join exams e on e.id=a.exam_id where a.user_id=p_user and e.track_id=p_track and a.status in ('submitted','graded','expired');
 return jsonb_build_object('summary',summary_,'history',history_,'lessons',lessons_,'daily_groups',portal_private.diagnosis_daily(p_user,p_track),
  'repeat_questions',(with repeated as materialized (select question_id from public.practice_notebook where user_id=p_user and tries>=2 and correct_streak<2) select count(*) from repeated n where (select portal_private.question_eligible(q,k,p_track,false) from public.questions q join public.question_keys k on k.question_id=q.id where q.id=n.question_id offset 0)));
end $function$
